overview.description: The MicroSectors U.S. Big Oil 3 Leveraged ETN (NRGU) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the Solactive MicroSectors U.S. Big Oil index. The fund tracks three times the performance of an equal-weighted index of US Oil & Gas companies. Index components are selected by market-cap NRGU was launched on Feb 19, 2025 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
